            a_new = a
        else:
            # Use all possible reduction on 'b'
            b_new = y
            n -= max_reduce_b
            # Now reduce 'a'
            max_reduce_a = a - x
            if n <= max_reduce_a:
                a_new = a - n
            else:
                a_new = x
                n -= max_reduce_a
        
        ans2 = a_new * b_new
        
        results.append(str(min(ans1, ans2)))
    
    print('\n'.join(results))
